response.sql: WITH winners AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank)') AS hand FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM winners) SELECT w.hand AS bats, COUNT(*) AS winners, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM winners w CROSS JOIN totals t GROUP BY w.hand, t.total ORDER BY winners DESC;
